sec.title: September 3 Archival Metadata Enrichment (Increment 705)
sec.p: This archival dispatch documents the historical provenance, broadcast scheduling, commercial sponsorship, credited cast, production personnel, alternate circulating titles, and pure narrative synopses for broadcasts transmitting on **September 3** across witty high-society husband-and-wife mystery banter penned by Dashiell Hammett for Post Toasties, momentous CBS London news relays capturing the exact moment Britain declared war on Nazi Germany, thrilling big-top animal trainer adventures in Bengal, interactive detective puzzles, and wartime Merchant Marine musical showcases, Les Damon and Claudia Morgan in *The Adventures of the Thin Man* (1941, 1943), Edward R. Murrow (1939), Clyde Beatty (1951), Frank Lovejoy (1948), and *We Deliver the Goods* (1939–1951):
